name: agent-roles
description: Three roles injected at the start of every agent — the top-level session orchestrates and delegates, a task worker ends its turn with findings, a resident worker stays alive and reports by message

resident_agent_types.title: Resident agent types
resident_agent_types.description: Agent types that stay alive for a whole run and report through SendMessage; they get the resident worker role instead of the task worker role. glab:mr-watch is always included.
